source: vision read of ALL 16 of the 16 flyer pages (weekly-1..16) installed by pull-fareway-ads.ps1 at 07:00 (ad_group OmahaGroup (043), manifest reports 16/16 pages on disk, no gaps, blocked=false). WINDOW TAKEN FROM THE AD'S OWN PRINTED FOOTER, 'Prices good August 24-29, 2026'. The manifest's weekly.from is 2026-08-23, one day earlier; the printed footer is the store's own statement of the window and wins, the same rule the 2026-08-17 file used when the filename month was an impossible '80'. weekly.to and the footer agree on 2026-08-29. PAGES 1-5 were read at 13:38; PAGES 6-16 were added at 16:2x by the 09:00 browser-stores agent, completing the flyer - all 16/16 pages have now been vision-read. The 6-16 pass covered beverages/snacks (6, 12), frozen & dairy (7, 13), produce (8), beer and local selections (9), spirits & wine (10), the Frank's Sizzling Deals recap (11, which mostly repeats pages 1-5 and contributed only 6 rows not already held), meat & deli (13), lifestyle/nutrition and personal care (14, 15), baby (15) and pets/household (16). EXCLUDED, as in prior files, every offer whose unit price the board cannot verify: the explicit 'WHEN YOU BUY N' conditionals (Pepsi/Mountain Dew 3/$10.88, Rosina Meatballs $5.99ea on 2, Fresh Sweet Corn $5/dozen on 12), the BOGO offers (King's Hawaiian Sandwiches, Bakery Fresh half pie) and the $25-basket Kellanova gift-card offer. Simple N/$X multi-buys carry no stated condition and are recorded at their arithmetic unit price, which is why ad_price is always a single figure: Ben's Original Rice Cups 2/$3.50 -> $1.75, Pork Loin Slices 10/$10 -> $1.00, ground beef patties 2/$6 -> $3.00, Lunchables 2/$5 -> $2.50. PAGES 6-16 EXCLUSIONS, same rule as pages 1-5 - every offer whose unit price the board cannot verify: the 'WHEN YOU BUY N' conditionals (Pepsi/Coke/7up 3 for $6.99ea on pages 6 and 11, Coke/Sprite 2L 2/$5 on 2, Protein Pints Save $2 on 2, Fareway shredded/cube/chunk cheese $1.88ea on 4, Pringles $2ea on 3, Little Debbie $4.99ea on 2, and every Save-$N-on-2 on pages 14-15 - Clif, Think!, Body Fortress, GoodSense pain relief, GoodSense loratadine, Mucinex, Xyzal, Lume/Mando, Dr. Teal's, Clean & Clear/Neutrogena, Colgate Total, Mrs. Meyers); the BOGO offers (Truly Yours snack mix, Paul Mitchell/Kenra, Johnson's baby care); and the Flonase $5-gift-card offer. Simple N/$X multibuys carry no stated condition and are recorded at their arithmetic unit price: Fareway Potato Chips 2/$5 -> $2.50, AE Sour Cream or Dip 4/$5 -> $1.25, Jose Ole Chimichangas 3/$5 -> $1.67. Two prices carry a restriction that does NOT change the unit price of the row recorded: Country Daybreak eggs 99c/dozen is LIMIT 2, and Whole Seedless Watermelon is recorded at its unrestricted $5.99 all-other-days price, not the $2.99 Wednesdays-only limit-1 price. Fresh Sweet Corn is recorded at the 75c each single price the ad prints alongside the excluded $5/dozen-on-12 conditional.
